name: Trent Ltd.
business_summary: Tata Group retailer: Zudio (value fashion, crossed 1,000 stores), Westside (premium fashion), Star Bazaar (hypermarket/grocery), plus emerging categories (beauty, footwear, Utsa, Samoh) and a stake in the Zara India JV (model knowledge). TTM sales Rs 22,001 cr (+18%), EBITDA Rs 4,169 cr (19%), net profit ~Rs 1,900 cr. Sep-26 quarter: sales Rs 5,873 cr (+22%), OPM 18%, PAT Rs 468 cr per screener (press: Rs 490 cr, +9%); Q2 business update 2026-10-06 showed revenue +23% to Rs 5,788 cr and the stock jumped 10-13%; after results it rose another 5-7%. Stock Rs 3,058 (market cap Rs 1.63 lakh cr), P/E 85, -34.5% over 12 months from its peak despite recent rally. Promoters (Tata group) 37.01%, FIIs 15.28% (from 25.9% in Dec 2023).

revenue_mix.segment: Star Bazaar and emerging (beauty, footwear, other)
revenue_mix.geography: India (emerging categories 21% of revenue per DSIJ 2026-10-30)

exposures.mechanism: Beta ~1.3 to urban discretionary spending: +5pp urban growth -> +6.5pp sales x 30% contribution on Rs 22,001 cr = Rs 429 cr = 10% of EBITDA Rs 4,169 cr; EV/MCap ~1.0; persistence 0.5 => +5.
Zudio's tier-2/3 expansion (small-town stores ~35-40% of footprint, model estimate): +5pp rural growth -> +1.5pp sales x 30% = Rs 99 cr = 2.4% of EBITDA x 0.5 => +1.2 to +1.5.
Aspirational-apparel spend tracks wage growth; +2pp wages -> +1.5pp sales; employee costs (~7%) rise offsets half => +1.5.

Cotton-linked inputs ~10% of Rs 17,832 cr costs; +10% cotton -> +6% garment cost = Rs 107 cr = 2.6% of EBITDA x 0.6 unrecovered x persistence 0.3 => -0.5 (Zudio holds price points). Empirical -1.16 (t=-0.8), same sign.
~15% of COGS imported/USD-linked (Bangladesh, China, beauty): +3% -> 0.0027 x costs = Rs 48 cr = 1.2% EBITDA x 0.6 x 0.5 => -0.35. Empirical -2.04 (t=-0.8) larger; kept -0.5.
Apparel up to Rs 2,500 already at the low slab after Sept-2025 rationalisation (model knowledge), so Zudio is largely unaffected by further cuts; 57th Council 2026-10-08 made no rate changes => +1.

Competition from Reliance (Trends/Yousta), Max, Style Union, Myntra and online value fashion: +1 cuts like-for-like growth ~2pp or margin 100 bp (~5% of EBITDA); x persistence 0.5 and premium multiple => -3.

evidence.note: Q2/H1 FY27 financials per screener.in pack; cost shares are model estimates unless stated

exposures.mechanism: 85x P/E, EV/EBITDA premium: +25 bp repo -> -3% fair value, half transmitted => -1.5. Interest cost is lease-related (Rs 178 cr).
FII holding fell from 25.9% (Dec 2023) to 15.3%; stock beta 1.3. Inflow reversal adds residual +1.5.

supply_chain.counterparty: Contract garment manufacturers (India, Bangladesh) and fabric mills

supply_chain.note: Model knowledge: Trent has a 49% JV with Inditex; also a premium-fashion partner.

supply_chain.counterparty: Reliance Retail (Trends, Yousta), Max, Myntra, Vishal Mega Mart
